highlight_subsections.heading: Bug Fixes
highlight_subsections.summary: * **Avoid blocking model launching when no system FFmpeg is available for TorchCodec** (#47888). Previously `import torchcodec` raised a `RuntimeError` at import time when system FFmpeg was missing, which blocked startup (e.g. `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct`) even when TorchCodec was not in use. The error is now deferred to runtime so it only surfaces if TorchCodec is actually needed. * **Guard mixed-dtype allreduce RMSNorm quant fusions** (#48330).
